not_en: Raster tile basemaps for the Jezero box (box D). Add these two entries to katmanlar.json. Tiles are Web Mercator XYZ with Mars longitude/latitude taken numerically as degrees (same convention as the 4-corner layers). Distances and times are computed from the 20 m grid, never from the map.

katmanlar.ad_en: CTX image mosaic, 5 m (Murray Lab global mosaic)
katmanlar.kaynak: NASA/JPL/MSSS/The Murray Lab. MRO Context Camera (CTX) Global Mosaic V01, tile MurrayLab_CTX_V01_E076_N16. Dickson et al. (2024), Earth and Space Science 11, doi:10.1029/2024EA003555; data doi:10.17189/m23v-ae12. https://murray-lab.caltech.edu/CTX/
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Free use for all purposes granted by the Murray Lab/Caltech. Shifted by a constant 46 m west and 16 m south to match the USGS Mars 2020 CTX orthomosaic; residual offsets of up to about 15 m remain locally because the source images are not individually controlled. Brightness is visually normalized, not calibrated reflectance.

katmanlar.kaynak: USGS Astrogeology / NASA, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX orthomosaic JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008_orthoMosaic_6m_Eqc_latTs0_lon0. https://planetarymaps.usgs.gov/mosaic/mars2020_trn/CTX/
katmanlar.guven_notu_en: Map base used for Perseverance terrain relative navigation; covers only the central 32 x 30 km. Smoother and cleaner than the Murray mosaic but with less fine detail. Reference for aligning the other layers.

istatistik.bicim: WebP, quality 80, 256 px, transparent outside data
